description: Frequency-response analyser — mainly useful to developers

params.text: Aligns the response for modules that add sample delay

inputs.text: A swept sine out to the module under test; RETURN — its output back
Patching here replaces the internal sweep

outputs.text: A pulse when a cycle starts, and another at EOC when it ends
A swept sine out to the module under test; RETURN — its output back

notes: plots both spectra and the difference between them
nothing is analysed until SEND is patched to the module under test and its output is patched back to RETURN, and a cycle is started by TRIG or by LOOP
clicking the display freezes it, so drag the module by its left edge, over the module's name, to move it
menu: Display traces — which traces are drawn: All, Analysis only, or Test/return only
Window — the window function applied before the FFT: None, Taper, Hamming or Kaiser
Frequency plot — plots the frequency axis Logarithmic or Linear
Frequency range — shows part of the spectrum rather than all of it: Lower 10%, Lower 25%, Lower 50%, Lower 75%, Full, Upper 75%, Upper 50% or Upper 25%
Amplitude plot — sets the vertical scale, Decibels to -60dB or Decibels To -120dB
Trigger on load — runs one cycle when the module or the patch is loaded, unless LOOP is already on

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
